:= by
  intros f hf a b
  have h1 : a - b ≤ a := le_tsub_add α a b
  have h2 : b ≤ a := by exact le_add_tsub α b (a - b)
  have h3 : f (a - b) ≤ f a := Monotone.imp hf h1
  have h4 : f b ≤ f a := Monotone.imp hf h2
  have h5 : f (a - b) - f b ≤ f a - f b := by
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]
    exact (Monotone.imp hf (le_trans (le_tsub_add α a b) (le_add_tsub α b (a - b))))
  exact h5
